picks.title: Several Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities Accidentally Posted To Public Kernel Mailing List
picks.summary: Seemingly as an accident, overnight several new Linux kernel vulnerability reports were posted to the public Linux kernel mailing list rather than the private security mailing list. The vulnerabilities have yet to be patched on mainline but at least in some cases there are patches undergoing testing
